rows.headline: GOLD AT LAST
rows.subhead: {winner} is the first manager to reach the golden mark, and the Golden Showdown now belongs to {winnerClub} forever.

rows.headline: THE GOLDEN AGE HAS A NAME
rows.subhead: This is the moment the history books were saved for, as {winner} claims the Golden Showdown ahead of {loser}.

rows.headline: CARVED IN GOLD
rows.subhead: Few feats will ever be recorded in this paper with more reverence than {winner} reaching the golden mark first.

rows.headline: A DYNASTY IS CROWNED
rows.subhead: The Golden Showdown is not won by accident, and {winnerClub} has built a dynasty that will be spoken of for generations.

rows.headline: THE GOLDEN CROWN
rows.subhead: {winner} is the first to the top of the mountain, and the crown of the Golden Showdown is placed upon the winning manager.

rows.headline: FIRST TO THE SUMMIT
rows.subhead: The race was long and fiercely contested, yet {winner} was the first manager to arrive, and the Golden Showdown is the prize.

rows.headline: THE GREATEST STORY WE PRINT
rows.subhead: Every other front page was practice for this one, in which {winner} stands alone as the Golden Showdown champion.

rows.headline: MELT THE SILVER, CAST THE GOLD
rows.subhead: A trophy of a rare and shining kind is being made, and {winner} has earned the right to lift it.

rows.headline: THE GOLD STANDARD
rows.subhead: From now on this is the measure that every other manager will be compared to, and {winner} is the one who set it.

rows.headline: ONCE IN A GENERATION
rows.subhead: Some contests produce a champion, and this one produced a legend, as {winner} became first to the golden mark.

rows.headline: THE GRAND FINALE
rows.subhead: The Golden Showdown reaches its glittering last scene, and {winnerClub} takes the final bow to a standing ovation.

rows.headline: THE BRIGHTEST STAR OF ALL
rows.subhead: Of all the lights on the console screen, none shines like the one that now marks {winner} as the Golden Showdown winner.

rows.headline: {loser} SALUTES THE GOLD
rows.subhead: The runner-up fought bravely through an epic chase, and now raises a hat to {winner}, who got there first.

rows.headline: THE LONGEST RACE, WON
rows.subhead: It was the greatest distance a manager could run, and {winner} reached the golden line before {loser} could close the gap.

rows.headline: STOP THE PRESSES
rows.subhead: This front page was held for a moment like no other, because {winner} has just won the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: THE ROAD TO GOLD ENDS HERE
rows.subhead: Years of seasons have led to this exact place, and {winner} is the manager who walked the whole way and arrived first.

rows.headline: THE FINEST VINTAGE
rows.subhead: Some things are worth waiting for, and {winnerClub} has produced the finest, rarest result this paper has ever served.

rows.headline: THE ARCHIVE BOWS DEEPLY
rows.subhead: Even the dusty shelves of the Gazette look brighter tonight, because {winner} has taken the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: THE TOP LINE TURNS TO GOLD
rows.subhead: The ledger has never printed a figure like this, and it belongs wholly to {winner}, the first to reach the mark.

rows.headline: FIRST NAME ON THE PLAQUE
rows.subhead: A fresh plaque is being polished, and the engraver has only one name to carve into it: {winner}.

rows.headline: LEGEND STATUS CONFIRMED
rows.subhead: There is no debate and no appeal, as {winner} becomes a legend by winning the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: LONG LIVE THE GOLDEN MONARCH
rows.subhead: All the realm bows to {winner}, whose reign in the Showdown now has the richest crown in the kingdom.

rows.headline: THE MOUNTAIN HAS A FLAG
rows.subhead: {winner} has planted it at the very top, where the air is thin and the Golden Showdown is finally within reach.

rows.headline: NOBODY CAME CLOSER
rows.subhead: {loserClub} made a gallant chase, but {winnerClub} got to the golden mark first, and only one manager can.

rows.headline: TOLD FOR GENERATIONS
rows.subhead: Years from now the story will be passed on, and {winner} will always be the name at the centre of it.

rows.headline: A COLLECTOR'S EDITION
rows.subhead: Keep this page, frame it, and show it to future generations as proof of the day {winner} won the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: THE GOLDEN DOOR OPENS
rows.subhead: One manager reached the entrance first, and {winner} now walks in as the undisputed owner of the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: THE LAST CHECKPOINT, CLEARED
rows.subhead: {winnerClub} has beaten the hardest level on the console and earned the rarest ending the save file can offer.

rows.headline: GILDED FROM TOP TO TOE
rows.subhead: {winner} has made the Showdown shine from every angle, from the dugout to the highest seat in the house.

rows.headline: THE GOLDEN CURTAIN FALLS
rows.subhead: The greatest production this paper has covered is over, and {winner} is the unrivalled star of the closing night.

rows.headline: THE ULTIMATE BRAGGING RIGHT
rows.subhead: Nobody will ever argue with {winner} again over who won the Golden Showdown, because the records are settled.

rows.headline: THE ENDLESS MILE, FINISHED
rows.subhead: The longest route the game offers has been run in full, and {winnerClub} is the first to see the golden line.

rows.headline: WHEN GOLD MEETS GLORY
rows.subhead: These two rarely appear on the same page, but {winner} has brought them together in the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: THE GOLDEN SHELF
rows.subhead: There is a very special place in the cabinet reserved for the Golden Showdown, and {winner} will be filling it.

rows.headline: TOP OF EVERY LIST
rows.subhead: Every column and every table agrees today, and {winner} appears first on all of them as Golden Showdown champion.

rows.headline: THE GOLDEN RECIPE
rows.subhead: It took patience, seasoning and years of hard work, but {winnerClub} finally has the perfect dish to show for it.

rows.headline: OUR FINEST HOUR
rows.subhead: The Gazette has never been prouder to print a result, since {winner} has made history with the Golden Showdown.

rows.headline: BEYOND ALL COMPARE
rows.subhead: There is nothing like it in the archive, and {winner} has set a standard that the book of records now bears.

rows.headline: THE FIRST AND ONLY
rows.subhead: Only one manager can be the first to get there, and the proud holder of that distinction is {winner}.

rows.headline: GOLD RUSH WINNER
rows.subhead: {winnerClub} dashed ahead in a thrilling race for the Golden Showdown, and no one else reached the golden mark in time.
